card.name: Nouns where differences are implied
card.fires_on: A noun like instructions, content, treatment or recommendations that comes right after a setup saying things differ or vary. It is strongest in "has different dosage and administration instructions than..." in drug labels.

modes.label: Different administration instructions
modes.description: The word instructions after "has different dosage and administration" when comparing a product to another form of the same drug.
modes.example: HERCEPTIN HYLECTA has different dosage and administration<< instructions>> than intravenous trastuzumab

modes.label: Varying content or treatment
modes.description: A noun about care or style that is said to vary or be tailored, in general web text.
modes.example: The diagnosis is often not clear-cut and the treatment<< recommendations>> can vary from doctor to doctor.

card.writes: It suppresses words like different, varying and 不同, so it seems to mark that the idea of difference has already been stated.
card.plain: It fires on the noun that completes a statement that something differs, such as instructions that are not the same as for another form.
